purpose: Close qualification phase 11 with an online digest of the exact post-head integer probabilities consumed by the arithmetic coder and mutation-scoped persistent-state checkpoints without retaining a multi-terabyte KH_TRACE stream.
activation_dependencies: cmix_filebacked_fxcm_full_a_qm8_v1 is terminal, exact, independently verified, and resource-clean
one independent full roundtrip B is terminal, exact, independently verified, and byte-identical to A
the exclusive full1g lease and its acquisition lock are absent
the observer patch, runner, schemas, build commands, checkpoint population, controls, and kill predicates are content-addressed

retained_trace_semantics.source_closure_behavior: The unpatched source writes KH_TRACE before KhBitLstm32Head::Adjust and is not itself the identity-build authority.
retained_trace_semantics.identity_build_behavior: The diagnostic identity build applies exact-integer-probability-trace.patch, moving KhWriteRes after KhBitLstm32Head::Adjust and immediately before the arithmetic range split.
retained_trace_semantics.calibration_rule: An online observer is valid only if its little-endian uint16 digest exactly reproduces the retained post-head opening and distant 10M trace digests.

pageout_cadence_reachability.evidence: FXCM::ByteUpdate calls gamma_filebacked_fxcm::ByteBoundary, but Predictor::Perceive never calls fxcm_model_.ByteUpdate; source-wide call-site search finds only the method definition.
pageout_cadence_reachability.resource_interpretation: The qm8 run uses the constructor's initial PageOutAll plus kernel reclaim induced by cgroup memory.high. It must not be described as exercising the declared 1,048,576-modeled-byte pageout cadence.
pageout_cadence_reachability.identity_consequence: None: the unreachable hook performs residency advice only and is not part of the predictor arithmetic.
pageout_cadence_reachability.successor_boundary: Do not repair this hook inside the measured qm8 candidate. Any repair is a new correction-only candidate and requires fresh resource evidence.

observer_contract.probability_tap: Encoder::Encode after optional KhBitLstm32Head::Adjust and immediately before xmid is computed
observer_contract.probability_record: two bytes containing the final uint16 probability in little-endian order
observer_contract.probability_digest: SHA-256 updated online through a bounded buffer; no per-bit trace is retained
observer_contract.probability_bit_count: Count only Encoder::Encode calls; exclude EncodeRawBit and ObserveKnownBit exactly as KH_TRACE does
observer_contract.coder_checkpoints: At frozen completed coded-byte indices, record x1, x2, emitted-payload-byte count, coded-bit count, and a clone-finalized rolling probability digest without resetting it.
observer_contract.observer_failure: Any open, write, flush, short-write, counter, checkpoint-order, or finalization failure terminates the diagnostic run; observation may never silently disable itself.

mutation_read_write_scope: fxcmv1::alloc allocations at or above 67108864 bytes
fxcmv1::alloc1 semantic data ranges at or above 67108864 bytes
persistent_state_contract.completeness_argument: The q1 semantic patch changes only allocation, release, and residency handling for these source-ordered large FXCM ranges. Predictor, head, mixer, coder, preprocessing, and every small allocation remain source-identical. Therefore these ranges are the complete persistent predictor state directly reachable by the memory mutation.
persistent_state_contract.registration: Both observer arms register the same source-ordered semantic ranges after allocation. Parent uses calloc-backed addresses; q1 uses each mapping's aligned usable pointer and requested_bytes. Virtual addresses, filenames, inode numbers, alignment padding, mapping slack, page residency, and page-fault history are excluded.
persistent_state_contract.checkpoint_digest: For each registered range, SHA-256 hashes a canonical header of allocation ordinal, requested semantic bytes, and alignment followed by exactly the semantic bytes. A manifest digest hashes the ordered per-range records.
checkpoint_population: after the final completed Encoder coded byte
persistent_state_contract.q1_residency_rule: Hash q1 mappings in bounded aligned chunks and issue only content-preserving pageout/drop advice for already hashed chunks. This phase is diagnostic and confers no resource or runtime qualification.
persistent_state_contract.parent_residency_rule: Hash parent semantic ranges read-only. Parent phase-11 memory is diagnostic and is not judged against q1's resource ceiling.
persistent_state_contract.identity_rule: Parent and q1 must have identical allocation geometry, checkpoint indices, per-range digests, aggregate manifest digests, coder checkpoints, final probability digests, payloads, and return codes. This proves mutation-scoped state identity only at the four frozen checkpoints; it is not continuous state-trajectory evidence.

controls: K observer-off and observer-on packages emit byte-identical 10M payloads and decoded streams
online post-head digests reproduce both retained 10M post-head digests and exact bit counts
a pre-head tap negative control differs from the retained post-head digest while leaving the payload unchanged
a copied-state single-byte mutation changes its range digest and aggregate manifest digest
checkpoint omission, duplication, reordering, or wrong coded-byte count is rejected
two observer builds from the same frozen closure are byte-identical within arm
execution_order: freeze and independently verify observer source and receipt schema
run opening and distant 10M calibration controls
run authoritative parent full byte-zero observer encode alone
run q1 full byte-zero observer encode alone from a clean build and scratch root
independently rederive calibration, manifests, payload identities, counters, and source hashes
only then emit the phase-11 identity decision
terminal_pass: Every calibration, probability, coder, persistent-state, payload, build, and independent-verification predicate is true.
terminal_identity_failure: Classify q1 as a new compression candidate without parent-preserving authority and restart its archive ladder. Do not reinterpret full payload equality as state identity.
terminal_observer_failure: Preserve all evidence and authorize at most one observer-only implementation correction; no semantic conclusion follows.
claim_boundary: A pass proves parent preservation for the exact q1 mutation under the frozen source, corpus, head, compiler, and host. It grants no Gamma compression bytes, score credit, runtime qualification, or official-prize authority.
